title: COMBO: Conservative Offline Model-Based Policy Optimization

methods.one_paragraph_description: Trains a probabilistic dynamics model ensemble on the offline data, collects short model rollouts from dataset states with rollout policy mu, and then alternates conservative policy evaluation and policy improvement: the Q-function is trained on a mixture d_f of real data (fraction f) and model rollouts with a CQL-style regularizer that pushes down Q-values on model-rollout state-actions rho(s,a) and pushes up Q-values on real dataset pairs, weighted by beta (Eq. 2). No explicit uncertainty estimation is needed; built on the MOPO/SAC implementation.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: model-based offline RL (paper: 'developing a new model-based offline RL algorithm, COMBO'; 'extending conservative Q-learning [29] ... into the model-based setting')
